description: End-to-end harness (scripts/e2e-sources.py) that the user/orchestrator can run against the deployed preprod mock URLs with the API key, plus docs/E2E-PLAN.md. The harness asserts HTTP 200 + verbatim payload shape for all 7, runs the adapter in mock mode against deployed ApiUrls, maps the Amazon listTransactions ORDER_ID related-identifiers into the SuperPoRequestDto field set (asserting order_ids[] is populated), and exercises the KYC payloads. Must be verifiable OFFLINE via a --self-test path using the local fixtures (no network). Depends on FEAT-003 (adapter) and FEAT-001/002 (payload shapes).
